name: handbook_2022_carry_forward_balance_dispute_case
use_case: Handle leave request boundaries such as insufficient balance, overlaps, or exceptions via HR case
branch: An employee references the 2022 handbook expecting 10 carried-forward leave days, and the assistant checks the document and opens a balance_dispute HR case.
tests: Verifies that the assistant creates a balance_dispute HR case for an employee disputing carry-forward allocation.
instruction:
You noticed your carry-forward balance from last year is missing. You cite the Employee Handbook 2022 which mentions up to 10 days of annual leave carryover. You want the assistant to look into the 2022 handbook and open an HR support case for a balance dispute so HR can investigate.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E431
- Name: Marcus Thorne
- Region: US
- Cited Document: Employee Handbook 2022
- Case Category: balance_dispute
- Subject: Missing carry-forward days from 2022 handbook entitlement

persona.name: Marcus Thorne
persona.initial_message: Hello, according to the 2022 Employee Handbook, I should have 10 carryover days, but they are not reflected. Can you open a balance dispute case?

arguments.subject: Missing carry-forward days from 2022 handbook entitlement
arguments.description: Dispute for 10 carryover days based on 2022 handbook
